facts.fact: The Regulation on Licensing and Organising Mobile Payment Financial Institutions 2020, issued under article 60(1) of the Banking Business Organisation Act 2004 (amended 2014), took effect on signature; the CBOS board approved it on 28 December 2020.
The 2020 regulation has the central bank licence companies, not banks, to run mobile payment and open e-money wallet accounts, with a rule that their names may not include 'bank'.

note: The regulation states no connection or interoperability requirement.
